Very Disappointing Stay at Aman Residency
I had a confirmed online booking at Aman Residency, but upon arrival, the owner refused to accept it and said they do not take online reservations. This was extremely unprofessional and caused unnecessary inconvenience.

The room was very dirty and unhygienic. Cleanliness standards were very poor, and even the surrounding area was not clean. It did not feel safe or comfortable at all.

The owner's behavior was rude and uncooperative. Instead of resolving the issue, he was arguing and acting according to his own wishes.

Overall, this was one of the worst experiences I have had. I would strongly not recommend Aman Residency to anyone.
